hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: submit
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: if set to true the files will be submitted

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: cd $SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/Alliance && rm -f ZFIN*.json* zfin_genes.gff3 && cp $SOURCEROOT/ZFIN*.json . && gzip ZFIN*.json cp $TARGETROOT/home/data_transfer/Downloads/zfin_genes.gff3 . cd $SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/Alliance && ./validateAllianceFiles.sh $submit $ALLIANCE_RELEASE_VERSION

mv $SOURCEROOT/ZFIN*.json $DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY/current
# createZfinExpressionInfoFile is part of createAllianceFiles, but its output is named in # lower case and so never matched the ZFIN*.json glob above -- it was neither published # nor removed, and accumulated in the checkout. Move it along with its siblings. Left as a # plain mv rather than rm -f: the file is written unconditionally by a task in the # createAllianceFiles graph, so a missing one means generation broke and should fail here. mv $SOURCEROOT/zfin_wt_expression.json $DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY/current
# validateAllianceFiles.sh reads authorization.txt and every filename relative to its own # directory, so the submission set has to be staged inside the checkout. Clear it out once # the submission has gone through -- the only tracked file in that directory is the script # itself, so everything staged there was left behind after every run. A failed validation # skips this builder and keeps the artifacts for debugging; the rm at the top of the # previous builder clears them on the next run. rm -f $SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/Alliance/ZFIN*.json.gz rm -f $SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/Alliance/zfin_genes.gff3
